translations.web: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
translations.bsb: He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”
translations.kjv: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
translations.asv: He saith in his heart, I shall not be moved; To all generations I shall not be in adversity.
